evals.name: plain-text-multi-page
evals.prompt: I have this PDF at data/sample_pdfs/sample_report.pdf — can you tell me what's on pages 1, 3 and 5? Quote the actual headings.
evals.expected_output: Three pages of text returned via Read; the answer cites concrete page-level headings with page numbers (e.g. 'Executive Summary' on p1, 'Regional Performance' on p3, 'Product Roadmap' on p5).

evals.name: with-image-figure
evals.prompt: Open data/sample_pdfs/sample_report.pdf at page 4 and describe whatever chart or figure appears there. I want you to actually look at the page image, not just the extracted text.
evals.expected_output: Read invoked with --with-image; the assistant inspects the page-image data URI from the result and describes the market-share bar chart rather than only PyPDF text.

evals.name: markdown-mode-table
evals.prompt: MinerU/Docling markdown lives at data/sample_pdfs/sample_report_markdown for this document. Read pages 1-2 of data/sample_pdfs/sample_report.pdf as structured markdown — preserve headings and any tables in your reply.
evals.expected_output: Read invoked with --markdown-dir; reply mode is 'markdown'; the response preserves markdown headings (e.g. '# Financial Highlights') and the quarterly revenue table rather than flattening to raw PyPDF text.
